_about: Malady Wise events calendar, used by the weekly topical run (and the monthly build). holidays: theme that day's Triviosis plus 1-2 other puzzles around puzzle_theme (full day for Halloween and Christmas Day); tag light = just 1-2 puzzles; gentle = respectful tone. anniversaries (MM-DD, every year): theme 1-2 puzzles, ideally Triviosis or Dxtective, and mention the anniversary in a hint or explanation. If a health day (data/health-days.json) falls on the same date, the health day leads. Facts must be double-checked before use.

holidays.name: New Year's Day
holidays.puzzle_theme: Resolutions and habits: exercise, sleep, quitting smoking, hangovers

holidays.name: Lunar New Year
holidays.puzzle_theme: Traditional and herbal medicine origins: ephedra, artemisinin, acupuncture

holidays.name: Shrove Tuesday (Pancake Day)
holidays.puzzle_theme: Breakfast biochemistry: carbs, gluten, coeliac disease, eggs, allergies

holidays.name: Valentine's Day
holidays.puzzle_theme: The heart: cardiology, love hormones (oxytocin, dopamine), broken heart syndrome

holidays.name: St Patrick's Day
holidays.puzzle_theme: Green things in medicine: bile, Pseudomonas, chloroma, green urine; alcohol and the liver

holidays.name: April Fools' Day
holidays.puzzle_theme: Medical myths and fakers: placebo, factitious disorder, mimics, red herrings

holidays.name: Easter
holidays.puzzle_theme: Eggs and chocolate: cholesterol, egg allergy, theobromine, caffeine, dental caries

holidays.name: Mother's Day
holidays.puzzle_theme: Obstetrics and maternal health: pregnancy, birth, breastfeeding

holidays.name: Halloween
holidays.puzzle_theme: Spooky medicine: bones, blood, zombies (catatonia), vampires (porphyria), werewolves (hypertrichosis), poisons

holidays.name: Christmas Eve
holidays.puzzle_theme: Festive hazards: overeating, gout, food poisoning, button batteries

holidays.name: Christmas Day
holidays.puzzle_theme: Christmas medicine: Christmas disease (haemophilia B), holly and mistletoe poisoning, reindeer red noses

holidays.name: Boxing Day
holidays.puzzle_theme: Sports medicine and leftovers: boxer's fracture, concussion, food safety

holidays.name: New Year's Eve
holidays.puzzle_theme: Party medicine: alcohol, hangovers, fireworks burns and eye injuries

holidays.name: Australia Day
holidays.puzzle_theme: Summer medicine: sunburn, melanoma, heatstroke, bluebottle and snake bites

holidays.name: Anzac Day
holidays.puzzle_theme: Military medicine history: triage, trench foot, blood transfusion, plastic surgery origins

holidays.name: Father's Day
holidays.puzzle_theme: Men's health: prostate, testicular cancer, heart health

holidays.name: Melbourne Cup
holidays.puzzle_theme: Horses, not zebras: common diagnoses, equine-named signs and terms (hoof, horseshoe kidney, cauda equina)
